title: Square-root-logarithmic scalar recentering and harmonic-BRST boundary

recentering_boundary.necessary_scale: Uniform semiboundedness of H_N-a_N requires liminf (6gC_N^2-a_N)/(g sigma_N sqrt(log N))>=sqrt(3)
recentering_boundary.excluded_window: Every scalar family with limsup (6gC_N^2-a_N)/(g sigma_N sqrt(log N))<sqrt(3) has bottoms tending to minus infinity
recentering_boundary.weak_compactness: The normalized bump trials lie in the fixed Gaussian unit ball and therefore have weakly convergent subsequences; the weak limit may be zero
recentering_boundary.mosco_failure: Along every excluded window the recentered form values tend to minus infinity, contradicting weak Mosco liminf for every finite semibounded candidate form
recentering_boundary.brst_transfer: Tensoring with K1471's fixed normalized degree-zero harmonic BRST vacuum preserves the values, weak convergence and exclusion window
